besluite.rede: 'heet' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans for naming a term, so the passive is a lateral move that also adds a second 'noem/genoem' next to 'Ons noem die hele 24 uur'.
No reader takes 'in jou bed' to mean the Earth; the fronted scene-setter reads well, and the clause only lengthens an already long sentence.

besluite.fout: Two verbs from different clauses meet ('wegkyk is') with no comma between them.
besluite.rede: The AWS comma between the end of the relative clause and the main verb makes the sentence easier to read and changes nothing in its meaning.

besluite.fout: Without a comma, 'teken om die beurt' can be read on first pass as drawing the spot in turns.
besluite.rede: The comma closes the relative clause, removes the misreading, and leaves the protected wording ''n kol wat jy op die bal teken' intact.
'as ekstra dag' is a normal Afrikaans role construction without an article, so adding ''n' is a lateral move, not a grammar fix.

besluite.fout: In the glossary entry read alone, 'dit' follows a sentence whose subject is 'Die Aarde' and can point to the Earth instead of the line.
besluite.rede: The pronoun fault is real, but it sits inside a [begrip] definition, which only the writer may reword.
